2363-4659-5224-5705.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {2}.
Glaring Fleshraker triggers, creating an Eldrazi Spawn token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Hangarback Walker resolves, entering with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Hangarback Walker.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Hangarback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Hangarback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

240-4247-5470-8296.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

3991-6132-6495.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat from step 3.
3991-6132-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

3240-3899-5477-6462.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Insidious Roots triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1129-4067-7890.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Allies.
1129-4067-7890.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Gleaming Splendor by paying {2}{W}, causing you and an opponent to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Harabaz Druid.
Repeat.

2060-2908-7889.description:
Cast Dream Stalker by paying its mana cost.
Dancing from Dark to Dawn's first ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Dream Stalker spell. When it enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2248-4300-7857.notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
2248-4300-7857.description:
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Elven Raft-Steerer triggers, untapping Skyshroud Ranger.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Repeat.

2021-2060-4029-7741.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

1263-2301-4871-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

193-1124-2724-3080-5299.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Activate Aminatou's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to loot.
Activate Aminatou's second ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Exchange of Words.
When Exchange of Words leaves the battlefield, its ability from Wormfang Manta's textbox triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.

1215-2523-2869.description:
Activate Hope of Ghirapur by sacrificing it.
When Hope of Ghirapur dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Hope of Ghirapur that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Hope of Ghirapur ability.
Repeat using the Hope of Ghirapur token

997-2908-4986--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Dream Stalker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dream Stalker enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dream Stalker
Repeat.
997-2908-4986--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any additional creature without summoning sickness you control

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

872-3259-5233--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
872-3259-5233--85--106.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2438-4120-4186-7352.notablePrerequisites: Vigor has indestructible, protection from creatures or protection from red.
2438-4120-4186-7352.description:
Cast Electric Seaweed by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Electric Seaweed enters, it triggers.
Activate Electric Seaweed by tapping it, attempting to deal 1 damage to Scurry Oak, which will instead put a +1/+1 counter on it due to Vigor.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Electric Seaweed triggers, dealing 1 damage to each non-Wall creature your opponents control. Each non-Wall creature you control (excluding Vigor) will not be dealt damage, and will instead have a +1/+1 counter put on it due to Vigor.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is paired with Sailor of Means

1409-5424-6753.description:
Activate Sailor of Means by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Sailor of Means enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Sailor of Means.
Resolve the Sailor of Means trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

2665-2719-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
2665-2719-7009.description:
Activate either Progenitor Mimic or Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat using the Avatar Kuruk token.

681-4693-6621-6763.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Mirrorpool can tap to produce at least {2}{C}
681-4693-6621-6763.description:
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands you control except Mirrorpool by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land other than Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 3 until Mirrorpool is the only land you control.
Activate Mirrorpool's second ability by paying {2}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, copying Splendid Reclamation.
Resolve the Splendid Reclamation copy, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Repeat from step 2.

1978-2750-4667.description:
Cause Elvish Aberration to become an artifact using Memnarch.
Activate Elvish Aberration by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Elvish Aberration.
Repeat from step 2.

2866-3518-4050-4986.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4050-5571-6331--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Repeat from step 2.

4375-5147-5361.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Auton Soldier enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Auton Soldier.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

333-4775-6797.notablePrerequisites: Necrogen Communion attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-4775-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1580-3967-4871-6663.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

222-527-4050-6633.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee, adding {1}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

1912-2665-3719-5326.notablePrerequisites: Progenitor Mimic has a power of at least 2.
1912-2665-3719-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Progenitor Mimic and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Progenitor Mimic from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Progenitor Mimic to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Progenitor Mimic enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Progenitor Mimic by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

1115-3259-5659.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1115-3259-5659.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Disa the Restless's second ability.
Resolve the Disa the Restless trigger, creating a Tarmogoyf creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Tarmogoyf token, then causing untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

565-1283-2909-4600.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Mind Games with buyback by paying {4}, targeting Chromatic Orrery.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Chromatic Orrery.
Resolve Mind Games, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead activate the Chromatic Orrery tokens using their second abilities, or target any other permanent.

830-1819-3681.notablePrerequisites:
Grafted Exoskeleton attached to Syr Konrad.
You have at least ten creature cards in your graveyard.
830-1819-3681.description:
Cast Bone Harvest by paying {2}{B}, putting at least ten creature cards on top of your library from your graveyard.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card that left your graveyard this way, giving each opponent that many poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

841-2292-4544-4677.notablePrerequisites:
You don't control a Ring-bearer.
You have a land card in hand.
841-2292-4544-4677.description:
Play a land card, triggering Dúnedain Rangers and Zendikar's Roil.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger, creating a 2/2 Elemental creature token.
Resolve the Dúnedain Rangers trigger, causing the Ring to tempt you, and causing the Elemental token to become your Ring-bearer.
Sméagol triggers.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Elemental, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Sméagol trigger, causing an opponent to reveal cards from the top of their library until they reveal a land card, then causing you to put the land onto the battlefield tapped under your control, and your opponent to put all other revealed cards into their graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Dúnedain Rangers and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Repeat from step 2.
NOTE: This combo can be stopped if an opponent runs out of lands in their library, so it is recommended to alternate opponents in between cycles to maximize the amount of iterations.

222-4050-4840.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Saproling.
222-4050-4840.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Myr Battlesphere and Slimefoot and Squee, adding two mana in any combination of {B}, {R} or {G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Myr Battlesphere and Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the Myr Battlesphere trigger, creating four 1/1 Myr creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing two Myrs, Myr Battlesphere and Slimefoot and Squee, adding {1}{B}{R}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

856-1201-1636-4241.notablePrerequisites: Witch's Oven does not have summoning sickness.
856-1201-1636-4241.description:
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Witch's Oven to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Witch's Oven by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, creating a Food token.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food token, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familar enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

1061-3942-4844.notablePrerequisites:
Timesteam Navigator does not have summoning sickness.
You have the city's blessing.
You have not cast a creature spell using Karador this turn.
1061-3942-4844.description:
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Cellar Door by paying {3} and tapping it, causing you to put Timestream Navigator from the bottom of your library into your graveyard and create a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Cast Timestream Navigator from your graveyard by paying {1}{U}.
Repeat each turn.
